annotations.title: Check a ZBS template draft (formal rules)

description: Check a ZBS template draft against the formal technical rules Zalo publishes: template name, title and text block lengths and parameter counts, table rows and cell lengths, number of buttons (2 vs 3 conflict reported as a warning), button text and URL length, parameters only in the URL path, one OA page button, logo PNG 400x96, image module 1-3 images 16:9 up to 500 KB, parameter types and sample lengths, and formal content hints (links or phone numbers in the text, icons, "anh/chị", superlatives in Tag 3). Types: custom, otp, rating, quick_response. Returns errors and warnings with the rule and the official page. Content is reviewed by Zalo, not here; the text is not stored. Example: {"template_type":"custom","tag":1,"title":"Order <order_code> confirmed","paragraphs":["Hello <customer_name>, your order <order_code> is on its way."],"buttons":[{"category":"business_website","text":"Track order","url":"https://shop.example.vn/track/<order_code>"}],"logo":{"format":"PNG","width":400,"height":96}}.

category.description: Button category (to check the one-OA-page-button rule).

phone.description: Call button number: fixed or one phone_number parameter.

url.description: Button link; parameters like <order_id> only in the path.

images.description: Image module files: width, height (px), size_kb.

logo.description: Logo file facts: format (PNG), width and height in px.

name.description: Template name (visible only to the business).

paragraphs.description: Text blocks (custom: 1-4; OTP and rating: one).

params.description: Declared parameters: name, Zalo type (customer_name, phone_number, address, code, custom_label, transaction_status, contact, personal_title, product_name, amount, time, bank_transfer_note, url_in_button, otp) and an optional sample value.

tag.description: Template tag: 1 transaction, 2 customer care, 3 promotion.

template_type.description: Template to check: custom (default), otp, rating, quick_response.
